value.rationale: The 26-vertex incidence is intrinsic to a smooth quartic del Pezzo surface: vertices are its complete exceptional curve and conic-fibration classes, and edges describe vertical exceptional components. Its full integral chip-firing group is a natural, exact global invariant strictly finer than eigenvalues or spanning-tree count; it is not a hand-picked subgraph or Picard-lattice identification.
